html: † כַּלְנֶה Am 6:2, prob. = כַּלְנוֹ Is 10:9 n.pr.loc. city (conquered by Assyria under Sargon?) poss. = כַּנֶּה (q.v.) Ez 27:23, 𝔊 om. in Am 6:2, Ξαλαννη Is 10:9; perhaps = Kullani (WklGesch. Bab. 225) i.e. (TomkinsPSBA Jan. 1883, 61) Kullanhou, near Aleppo, conquered by Tiglath-Pileser III in 738 (COT ii, 195); or (Di) Kunulua (KG217 KB i, 107), SE. of Antioch (cf. Dr Am 6:2).
